admission.justification: Sending unsupported host keys can produce false suppression claims without changing harness behavior.

applicability: The launch-call to pinned host create-payload boundary, including the bridge.
conditions: Only host-read provider options are sent as the suppression mechanism.
exclusions: An internal record is not itself proof that a host consumes an exclusion.
statement: The create request carries no key the pinned host does not read: the exclusion record stays in the launch call, and of it only `providerOptions` reaches the host.
